media.description: Detail cropped from the page carrying the entry "J. WALTER RUBEN" in the digitised copy of the book; the archive reproduces the portrait alone, and the full page with its biographical text remains consultable in the scan.
media.publicCaption: J. Walter Ruben, who directed Trouble for Two in 1936. The portrait accompanies his entry in the publicity reference book Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer issued in 1937.
media.publicCreditLine: Photographer unnamed; Who's Who at Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer (Culver City: Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer, 1937), entry "J. WALTER RUBEN"; digitised by the Media History Digital Library from the copy in the collection of Karl Thiede.
media.rightsNote: Public domain in the United States. Who's Who at Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer was issued in 1937 by the studio's publicity department as a reference book for the press. The digitised copy carries no copyright notice: none appears on the title page, on the leaves facing it, or in the end matter, and a United States work published in 1937 without notice entered the public domain on publication. Had a notice been present, the copyright would in any case have required renewal in 1964 or 1965. No photographer is credited for the individual portraits.
